plainText:
Torchic (Japanese: アチャモ Achamo) is a introduced in Generation III.

It evolves into starting at level 16, which evolves into starting at level 36.

Along with and , Torchic is one of the three first partner Pokémon of Hoenn available at the beginning of Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire, , Omega Ruby, and Alpha Sapphire.

==Biology==
Torchic is a small, chick with stubby, downy, yellow wings. Its body is covered with orange feathers and a fluffy coat of down. There is an orange and yellow crest on its head that resembles a flame. Its two thin legs and short beak are a light brownish yellow, and the feet have three toes in front and one in the back. A male Torchic will have a small black speck on its rear that is not present in females.

Within Torchic's belly, this Pokémon has a flame sac filled with a burning fire. This internal flame causes Torchic to feel warm if hugged. The warmth feels similar to a warm water bottle. As long as Torchic is alive, the internal flame will burn continuously. When attacked, it will shoot fireballs of 1,800 °F (1,000 °C) at its foes, leaving them scorched black. It dislikes darkness, as it cannot see its surroundings. Torchic will follow its with unsteady steps. While Torchic is rarely found in the wild, it is known to inhabit . It has been recently seen living in the Terarium of Blueberry Academy. As mentioned in Sleep Style Dex, its fluffy body is warm enough to sleep next to.

===Main series===
 
====Major appearances====
=====May's Torchic=====
 started her Pokémon journey with a Torchic that she obtained in Get the Show on the Road!, thus also marking the species' animated series debut. It evolved into a Combusken in A Shroomish Skirmish, and later into a Blaziken in Once More with Reeling!.

=====Other=====
In Having a Wailord of a Time, , Max, and were given the task of watching over a Torchic and the rest of the Hoenn first partner Pokémon for Nurse Joy while May was practicing with her . Torchic managed to evolve into a Combusken and had to be hidden. However, Nurse Joy eventually found out about this and allowed it to stay at the Pokémon Center.

In Pikachu and the Pokémon Music Squad, a Torchic fought with and over a Pecha Berry.

In A Crowning Moment of Truth!, five Trainers' Torchic attended the Wela Fire Festival. A Torchic belonging to a sixth Trainer also appeared in a flashback.

A Torchic appeared in a fantasy alongside its evolved forms in Crowning the Chow Crusher!.

Like her counterpart, received a Torchic nicknamed Chic from her father Professor Birch sometime prior to Making Mirth with Mightyena. Just like Chic's Trainer, she loves to battle. ===Super Smash Bros. Brawl===
After being released from a , Torchic is engulfed in flames and burns nearby brawlers. It traps its victim(s), causing a moderately large amount of damage for the duration of its time on the field. Torchic launches trapped opponents as it leaves the stage.

====Trophy information====
"A Chick Pokémon. It's a Fire-type that has a flame sac in its belly where it produces fireballs reaching 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit--it shoots these out of its mouth. While Torchic is as cute as can be, it evolves into the powerful Combusken when it levels up. It also then becomes a Fire and combination."
 
 

==Trivia==
Torchic and its evolved forms are the only Pokémon in a first partner Pokémon evolutionary line to all have gender differences.
Additionally, Torchic is the only Pokémon in the first stage of a first partner Pokémon to have gender differences (although its own is very easily missed, being only a one-pixel difference).
Torchic is the only one of a first partner .

===Concept and development===
 
Concept art from portrays a different Torchic design, with large floppy ears and a flame-shaped marking on the back of its head.

===Origin===
Torchic is based on a hatchling. In particular, Torchic's bright orange coloration is based on painted chicks, which are chicks whose feathers are dyed with paint and are typically sold during festivals and fairs. It may also be specifically based on the , a legendary fire-breathing chicken in Japanese folklore.

Torchic's gender difference may be based on , a technique that originated in Japan, where feces is squeezed out of the chick in order to open its , allowing the chick sexer to observe whether it has a bump inside its cloaca. Normally, only male chicks have this bump.

====Name origin====
Torchic is a combination of and chick (a baby bird). 

Achamo may be a combination of 赤ちゃん akachan (baby) and 軍鶏 (a breed of Japanese chicken once raised for fighting).
